answer: The onyx counter is kept in pigment and nadir publishes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 31 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 31 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 128 aliases cost 372 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
